title: Follow the clustering download helper
description: You inspect the artifact check and recorded download fallback.

steps.description: You import archive and path tools, then try to load Colab's files helper. The try block also encloses archive creation and download.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. The other branch prints a missing-folder message.

steps.question: Where does an exception from files.download go?
steps.answer: The except block prints the helper-unavailable message followed by the exception text.

steps.description: You see that fallback in the recording. It identifies google.colab.files.download as unavailable in code-viz.
